name: Icelance
body:
School conjuration (creation) [cold]; Level druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a clear stone, glass or gemstone worth at least 50 gp, or 10 lbs of snow or ice)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one lance of ice
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to affect the target with the icelance. If the attack hits, you deal 1d6 damage per level (maximum 10d6).

Half of the damage is piercing, the other half is cold damage. Additionally, the target must make a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1d4 rounds. After striking or missing its target, the icelance shatters.
